I have 10.1 mu. Same as every year — winter wheat first, then summer maize right after I cut the wheat in June. This is what everyone here does, has been this way long as I remember.

For the wheat, before I plant in October, I spread compound fertilizer. I buy 2 bags per mu from the dealer in town, each bag 40 kg. So 80 kg per mu. That's what my neighbor Zhang sao does and her wheat is always good. Then when the wheat turns green in spring, I spread urea — half a bag per mu, about 20 kg. If I put less I get scared the wheat won't fill. Better to spend the extra money than see thin ears.

Maize I plant right after cutting wheat, no time to plough, I just use the seeder behind the small tractor — one bag of compound per mu at planting, then when maize is up to my knee I put urea between the rows, maybe 30 kg per mu. Hybrid seed, always. The old kinds don't give anything. The dealer tells me which one everyone is buying this year and I buy that.

Water — I have the well, thank heaven. Wheat I water 4 times: before winter, when it turns green, at jointing, and when grain is filling. Maize usually gets the summer rain but if July is dry I pump water once or twice.

Pesticide — 2 times on wheat, aphids and the yellow disease. 2 times on maize, borer and weeds. The man with the sprayer cart comes through the village, I pay him.

Last year wheat gave me about 480 kg per mu, maize 550. Should be about the same if the rain comes right.
